rows.title: Only an active connection
rows.defect: the connection's status is not checked
rows.test: a revoked connection is not read

rows.title: Read permission for bills
rows.test: a connection without read_obligations is not read

rows.title: Every fact from the biller
rows.defect: the record's free reference field replaces the biller's id
rows.test: the bill's reference is the biller's own id

rows.title: Verified needs unpaid confirmed
rows.defect: only an explicit false confirmation downgrades the bill

rows.title: Partially paid needs it too
rows.test: partially paid without confirmation is asserted

rows.title: Another account is refused
rows.defect: the record's account is not compared with the connection's
rows.test: a record for mock-acct-OTHER is refused

rows.title: Version 1 or more
rows.defect: the version floor is off by one

rows.title: One bill once per batch
rows.test: the same external id twice is refused

rows.title: Not later than now
rows.test: an observation 1 ms after now is refused

rows.title: Now is never the observation time
rows.defect: a missing observation time is filled with now
rows.test: a record with no observed_at is refused

rows.title: One bad record rejects the batch
rows.defect: the good records are kept while the batch reports errors
rows.test: a good bill next to a -$0.01 bill stores nothing

rows.title: 500 records at most
rows.defect: the batch limit is off by one

rows.title: A bill states its currency
rows.defect: a missing currency becomes USD (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a record with no currency is refused, not read as USD

rows.title: The connection stamps the evidence
rows.defect: the record's evidence is spread last, over the connection's stamp
rows.test: a record cannot claim another connector or its own unpaid confirmation

rows.title: Bad amounts and dates are refused
rows.defect: a record that fails validation is skipped silently
rows.test: a -$1.00 bill is refused with invalid_amount

rows.title: Ids stay short and printable
rows.defect: the id length limit is ten times too long
